text:
Maria K: FYI invoice-preview: ~200 tenants show negative credits after last night's backfill. Looks correlated with high deferred-ingest spikes from 02:00-03:00 UTC. Anyone on the metering side see anomalies? :eyes:
Jonah L: saw the spike, I think rate-limiter shadow queue delayed route resolution so events landed untagged -> counted as global free-tier usage.
Prasanna: If events miss route tag we fallback to `route_id = NULL` which later maps to default SKU. That's dangerous.
Maria K: exactly — preview shows default SKU -> 0 cost so credits go negative when invoices reconcile.
ops-bot: deploy succeeded for metering-converter v1.4.2 at 2024-05-12T03:10Z
Jonah L: quick check — upstream protobuf change? I grep logs, found `route_hint` present but `ingest_priority` absent in ~12% of events during spike.
Prasanna: aha — converter assumes `ingest_priority` only from edge attrs; when it's missing we override route tag based on rate-limiter hint. Race there.
Maria K: can we patch converter to prefer `route_hint` when `ingest_priority` is missing instead of defaulting to NULL?
Prasanna: yes, small change. Proposed SQL to mark suspect events:
```
SELECT event_id FROM metering.events
WHERE timestamp >= '2024-05-12T02:00:00Z' AND (route_tag IS NULL OR route_tag = '')
AND source = 'edge-proxy' LIMIT 100;
```
Jonah L: also suggest we add a dashboard alert on percent-unattributed tokens > 1% for hourly window. Current dashboard shows spike but no alert.
Maria K: +1, create alert and a temporary fix: reprocess affected window with `route_hint` enrichment and recompute preview.
Prasanna: will open a tiny PR for converter defaulting logic, add unit tests. Canary to 10% of traffic first.
Jonah L: I'll handle the reprocess job and dashboard alert. Can we get ops coverage for the canary rollout at 03:30 UTC? :thumbsup:
Maria K: tagging @Prasanna @Jonah L — please coordinate. If anything goes sideways, rollback to v1.4.1. :warning:
ops-bot: reprocess job queued (job-id: rpx-829001)
Prasanna: PR opened: metering/converter#542. Patch changes fallback order + adds metric `metering.unattributed_token_rate` (prom counter).
Maria K: perfect. After canary, let's schedule a postmortem note for billing team so finance knows about provisional credits.
Jonah L: will draft short note and ping finance. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
